The general lots of the Kingdom which is from the Lord's Divine Spiritual. Signified.

It is said the general lots, because the Lord's Kingdom is represented by the Land which is distributed by lots among those to whom it is given as an inheritance to be possessed; as was the Land of Canaan to the sons of Israel. The lots in general are twelve; for by twelve are signified all things of charity and the derivative faith...
